game.title: Heavy Rain
game.engine: Quantic Dream in-house engine (2019 PC port)
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-09-17 on RTX (home PC, 3440x1440 desktop): launched, reached the main menu and Options -> Graphics, set windowed 1280x720, closed. Our d3d11.dll logging proxy was present; its log shows D3D11CreateDevice [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1].

input.api: Win32 messages; the menus are MOUSE-driven (clicks at screen coordinates), Esc = back
api_notes: Menu items accept synthetic mouse clicks at screen coordinates [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1]. Esc goes back one level.
Enter from the keyboard did NOT confirm the 'keep these settings?' dialog after Apply (see disproved).

bindings.notes: Opens a 'keep settings?' confirmation with a 15 s revert timer.
Enter did not confirm; the timer ran out and the settings reverted once. The user then confirmed by hand. A mouse click on its button is the untested next route.

states.name: main_menu
states.detect: The game's main menu, about 30 s after launch; borderless 3440x1440 by default on this machine.

states.name: options_graphics
states.detect: Options -> Graphics: Resolution row with left/right arrows, Display Mode row with arrows (Borderless / ... / Windowed), F = Apply.

states.name: keep_settings_confirm
states.detect: A 'keep these settings?' dialog with a 15 s countdown that reverts the change.

states.name: exit_confirm_win32
states.detect: A native Win32 message box 'ARE YOU SURE YOU WISH TO EXIT GAME?' with OK, raised by WM_CLOSE.

steps: Resolution: click the RIGHT arrow repeatedly. The list WRAPS: after 3440x1440 come 640x480, 720x480, 720x576, 800x600, 1024x768, 1152x864, 1176x664, 1280x720 ... Read the shown value after each click.
Display Mode: arrows to Windowed, verify
confirm 'keep settings?' within 15 s. Enter does NOT work; the user clicked it by hand.
routes.notes: Worked once with a manual confirm. The file route (entry_points.config_files) avoids the timer.

steps: PostMessage WM_CLOSE to the game window
a Win32 box 'ARE YOU SURE YOU WISH TO EXIT GAME?' appears
send BM_CLICK to its OK button

config_files: <game folder>\user_setting.ini [GRAPHIC_SECTION]: Resolution=1280 x 720 and ScreenMode=2 = WINDOWED (the menu showed Windowed while the file read 2) [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1]. What ScreenMode 0 and 1 mean is not established.
entry_points.proxy_dll: d3d11.dll beside HeavyRain.exe (logging, full export); log shows D3D11CreateDevice [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1].

hazards.hazard: Graphics changes revert after 15 s unless confirmed
hazards.notes: Apply (F) opens a keep-settings dialog with a 15 s timer. Enter does not confirm it and the change reverted once. Edit user_setting.ini with the game closed instead.
It raises a Win32 'ARE YOU SURE YOU WISH TO EXIT GAME?' box. Click OK (BM_CLICK works), then verify the process has gone before the next step.
Pressing right past the desktop resolution wraps to 640x480. Read the shown value; do not press a fixed count.

disproved.claim: Enter confirms the 'keep these settings?' dialog
disproved.result: No - the 15 s timer ran out and the settings reverted.
